titleEn: Top up the wallet by card (Kashier)

en: How do I top up my wallet?
I paid and the balance did not grow

steps: See card fee added on top; wallet gets the full amount
Pay on Kashier; balance grows when Kashier confirms by webhook
edgeCases: Card top-ups can be off: use InstaPay
Confirmation is by webhook not return; stuck top-ups repaired by daily inquiry
Payment page opens outside the app: mobile browser return
gaps: No receipt/invoice download for top-ups other than the CSV statement
assistantNote: moves money; the merchant pays on the Kashier page themselves
